## Checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused and preserve other contributors' work.
- [ ] Relevant checks were run; unverified scope is documented honestly.
- [ ] Whitespace, conflict markers, document links, and roadmap dependencies pass.
- [ ] Both README versions are updated for status or scope changes.
- [ ] Related documentation, acceptance criteria, and failure paths are updated.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or unauthorized third-party content are included.
- [ ] Contributions can be submitted under MIT; third-party licenses are identified.
